'''Eric Carbone''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[January 2000 Boca Raton tournament (23 January)]] on 23 January 2000 with [[Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|MWYHL]], according to Mike Fitzgerald's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d198">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-23-titans-boca-raton-florida-1-23-00d198/ titans-boca-raton-florida-1-23-00], DeckTech (Mike "Iceman" Fitzgerald, 23 January 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-23-titans-boca-raton-florida-1-23-00d198/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
